Metadata.title: BookHive
Metadata.description: Search the catalog, check availability, and manage your loans, holds and fines online.

Home.heroSubtitle: Search the library catalog, see what's on the shelf right now, and reserve books before you visit.
Home.subjectsSubtitle: Organised by the Dewey Decimal Classification, just like our shelves.
Home.joinText: Apply online in a few minutes. Once approved, your digital library card is ready on your phone.

availability.title: Check availability
availability.text: See how many copies are on the shelf and exactly where to find them.

reserve.title: Reserve books
reserve.text: All copies out? Join the queue and we'll tell you when it's your turn.

renew.title: Renew from home
renew.text: See your due dates and renew loans without coming to the desk.

pay.title: Pay fines online
pay.text: Pay by card, eZ Cash or mCash and get a receipt by email.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the library.
